description:
Proton VPN indicator for the top panel.

Shows the active NetworkManager Proton profile name in the panel. When the official app has written connection_persistence.json for that connection, the menu also shows protocol and offers Copy Server IP.

Menu actions activate or deactivate existing NetworkManager Proton profiles (Connect / Reconnect / Disconnect / pinned servers from tray_pinned_servers). They do not call Proton's connect API. Open app for Fastest opens the official app so you can pick a server there.

Also shows spoofed GeoClue coords from /etc/geolocation and can run pkexec vpn-location-sync sync.

This extension is not affiliated, funded or in any way associated with Proton VPN.
name: Proton VPN Indicator
